name: Every point-of-interest type belongs to exactly one of 6 groups
eval: const all = POI_GROUPS.flatMap(g => g.types); return { groups: POI_GROUPS.map(g => g.id), total: all.length, unique: new Set(all).size, poiTypes: Object.keys(POI_TYPES).length, allKnown: all.every(t => POI_TYPES[t]) }

name: Types map to the agreed groups (turns stay 'turn', unknown → generic)
Each group has its own marker colour on the map
eval: await openFromUrl(location.origin + '/samples/roundabouts-and-pois.gpx'); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 200)); const col = {}; for (const w of wptItems) { if (w.fixed) continue; col[typeCat(w.type)] = getComputedStyle(w.marker._icon.querySelector('div')).backgroundColor; } return { cats: Object.keys(col).sort(), distinct: new Set(Object.values(col)).size === Object.keys(col).length }

name: A selected waypoint keeps its type colour and gets a blue ring
eval: const w = wptItems.find(w => w.type === 'Water_point'); const before = getComputedStyle(w.marker._icon.querySelector('div')).backgroundColor; selectWpt(wptItems.indexOf(w), { from: 'map' }); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 200)); const d = getComputedStyle(w.marker._icon.querySelector('div')); return { sameColour: d.backgroundColor === before, ring: d.boxShadow.includes('rgb(31, 111, 235)') }

name: The type picker lists points of interest under 6 group headings
eval: const det = document.querySelector('#editor-slot details'); return { headings: [...det.querySelectorAll('.tgroup')].map(h => h.textContent), buttons: det.querySelectorAll('.tbtn').length }
